rationale: The ES 8.2 feature row names TAXII 2.0 and 2.1 for ES 8.2 and later and points to the native feed task. The compatibility section on that same 8.2 page instead lists 1.0 and 1.1. The ES 8.8 compatibility paragraph duplicates 2.0. The 8.8 task expressly covers native threat intelligence and separately discusses STIX parsing. The 8.8 TIM Cloud highlight adds connector authentication options. The exact current minor protocol list remains uncertain; both published statements are preserved.

deployments: Native threat intelligence and separate TIM Cloud connector
exclusions: No current TAXII 2.1 support or removal is inferred. TIM Cloud authentication and STIX document parsing do not establish the native TAXII protocol version.
